# Commands the guard must deny, one per line as <message key>|<command>. The reason has to be that key's message,
# so every alternative the guard offers is checked. Same setup as guard_allow.txt.
# Keys that need more than a command (review_wait, review_block, review_unread, lane, gated) have their own tests.
